iko.text: Jirina Kudro, daughter of General Kudro of Drannith, watches the Battle at the Ozolith, where Lukka touches the crystal, gains great but unbalanced power, and forms an army of beasts.

Her father imprisons Lukka after his betrayal, and Jirina helps him escape by faking her kidnapping, but at a parley Lukka murders General Kudro before her eyes, and when she refuses to join him she attacks him and flees into a river.
Rescued by Vivien and a bonder, Jirina returns to Drannith, deposes Colonel Bryd and takes command, holding a war council and calling the bonders to help as Lukka's army arrives.

She confronts Lukka on Yidaro's shell, and the bonders charge through the gates to rescue her, turning the tide, until the Ozolith overloads and Lukka's spark ignites, after which she becomes colonel and lets bonded humans and monsters live in the First Ring.
